name: ccx
description: ccx - claudecodex: sync task context between Claude, Codex and Antigravity. Import a Claude Code session or Antigravity conversation into this thread, keep them in sync, or hand this thread over. Menu bar ⇄ and the other apps' side: github.com/aaronwong1999/ccx

interface.shortDescription: Sync task context between Claude, Codex and Antigravity
interface.longDescription: Links a Codex thread with a Claude Code session and an Antigravity conversation so you can keep working on the same task in any of them: the others' new progress is brought into the conversation you are in. Not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google.
